purpose: Prove which same-session diagnostic channels survive Safari startup and recovery without changing fleet behavior.
requirements: Window-memory witness is authoritative for current page execution and cannot silently fail.
sessionStorage and localStorage probes must expose exact success or exception text.
Automatic safe recovery pauses briefly for evidence capture with Continue Now.
Settled Engine login shows a temporary post-login evidence hold with channel state and recovery identity.
Engineering Evidence reads window-memory truth first and uses storage only as corroboration.
